integrity: The claim is supported by an exhaustive standard-library maximal-clique census and complete natural-group orbit check. Literature comparisons distinguish minimum-distance FPAs from the stricter exact-distance EFPA problem.
scientific_limitations: Finite parameter-specific classification for ternary composition (2,2,2), length 6, minimum Hamming distance 4. It does not classify other parameters or submaximum codes. A residual originality risk is an unindexed historical table or computational census.
title: Complete classification of optimal ternary frequency-permutation codes of length six and distance four
